def test_matching(N, s, cover):
    # cover is a list of (indices, values)
    B = nx.Graph()
    for k, (indices, values) in enumerate(cover):
        # For each sub-cube, the possible (i, v) pairs
        for idx, val in zip(indices, values):
            B.add_edge(k, (idx, val))
    
    matching = nx.bipartite.matching.hopcroft_karp_matching(B, top_nodes=range(len(cover)))
    return len(matching) // 2 == len(cover)
